lines: Karoge yaad to har baat yaad aayegi
couplets.en: When you remember, every little thing will come back.

lines: Guzarte waqt ki har mauj thahar jaayegi
couplets.en: Every wave of passing time will come to rest.

lines: Yeh chaand beete zamaanon ka aaina hoga
couplets.en: This moon will mirror ages gone by.

lines: Bhatakte abr mein chehra koi bana hoga
couplets.en: A face will have taken shape in a drifting cloud.
A lonely road will tell a tale.

lines: Barasta bheegta mausam dhuaan dhuaan hoga
couplets.en: The rain-soaked season will blur like smoke.

lines: Pighalti shaamon pe dil ka mere gumaan hoga
couplets.en: In the melting dusk, you may glimpse my heart.

lines: Hatheliyon ki hina yaad kuchh dilaayegi
couplets.en: The henna on your palms will bring something back.

lines: Gali ke mod pe soona sa koi darwaaza
couplets.en: A lonely doorway stands at the bend in the lane.

lines: Tarasti aankhon se raasta kisi ka dekhega
couplets.en: With longing eyes, it will watch for someone to come.

lines: Nigaah door talak jaake laut aayegi
couplets.en: The gaze will wander far before returning.

lines: Karoge yaad to har baat yaad aayegi
couplets.en: When you remember, every little thing will come back.

couplets.en: Every wave of passing time will come to rest.
